mapper.select: SELECT U."userNo", U."userName", UI."userBirth", '접속중' AS "status", -- 수학 공식(Haversine)으로 거리 계산 (안전한 방식) ROUND( 6371 * ACOS( LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(MY_LOC.LATITUDE * 0.0174532925) * COS(YOUR_LOC.LATITUDE * 0.0174532925) * COS((YOUR_LOC.LONGITUDE - MY_LOC.LONGITUDE) * 0.0174532925) + SIN(MY_LOC.LATITUDE * 0.0174532925) * SIN(YOUR_LOC.LATITUDE * 0.0174532925) )) ), 1 ) AS "distance", ( SELECT LISTAGG(IMG."imageUrl", ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IMG."imageProfile" DESC, IMG."imageNo") FROM "userImage" IMG WHERE IMG."userNo" = U."userNo" ) AS "images" FROM "users" U JOIN "userInfo" UI ON U."userNo" = UI."userNo" JOIN "USER_LOCATIONS" YOUR_LOC ON U."userNo" = YOUR_LOC."USERNO" INNER JOIN ( SELECT LATITUDE, LONGITUDE FROM "USER_LOCATIONS" WHERE "USERNO" = #{userNo} ) MY_LOC ON 1=1 WHERE U."userNo" != #{userNo} -- 필터링 해제 상태 유지 (데이터 확인용) ORDER BY "distance" ASC
